data.exact_reserve_text: The syndicate has experienced a positive run off deviation of GBP 3,714k in the year, predominately in respect of Accident and Health business (2016: GBP 3,031k, predominately in respect of Property and Accident and Health businesses).

named_events.event_name: storm and earthquake losses experienced in the third quarter
named_events.loss_description: The 2017 claims ratio has been adversely impacted by the storm and earthquake losses experienced in the third quarter.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 were GBP 77.173m. During 2017 the Syndicate reported a positive run-off (release) of GBP 3.714m in respect of prior years, predominately in Accident & Health, representing approximately a 4.8% favourable movement on opening reserves. The report also notes that 2017 claims ratios were adversely impacted by storm and earthquake losses in Q3 (current-year events) but the prior-year movement reported was a net favourable run-off.
raw_causal_phrases: positive run off deviation of GBP 3,714k in the year, predominately in respect of Accident and Health business
The 2017 claims ratio has been adversely impacted by the storm and earthquake losses experienced in the third quarter, as noted in the Chief Executive Officer's report.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet liabilities (Claims outstanding, comparative 2016 column). Prior-year movement taken from the Claims Outstanding note language describing a 'positive run off deviation of GBP 3,714k' (interpreted as a gross prior-year release). The report does not give a full gross PYD reconciliation line labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision' with an explicit 'Insurance liabilities' column; narrative phrase in the claims note was used (flagged as reasonably confident). LOB split of the PYD is not quantified in the note.
